purpose: Frozen diagnostic labels created before any model run on this holdout. These labels describe whether the fixed evidence input proves maturity; they are not training labels and do not assert global technology maturity.

rubric.present: A trust-tier A or B passage directly states standardization, real adoption/deployment, or established market/infrastructure use of the candidate itself.
rubric.absent: The fixed passages contain no qualifying direct maturity evidence.
rubric.uncertain: The passages contain a plausible maturity hint, but the candidate relation, source trust, or real-world status is too ambiguous for a binary verdict. Excluded from metric denominators.

items.rationale: The passages describe deployed IoT sensors and AIoT applications, but do not clearly establish that the combined AIoT candidate itself is already adopted as ordinary infrastructure.
The only present-tense deployment statement has unknown trust; the trust-tier A passage is future-tense.
The passages describe reviews, experiments, proposed uses, performance, and deployment implications rather than established adoption of autoencoders.
The passages propose and evaluate new auditing mechanisms; maturity statements apply to adjacent cloud or blockchain technology, not dynamic data auditing itself.
A broad usage claim is from an unknown-trust source; trust-tier A passages do not directly prove established deployment of the candidate.
The fixed passages concern experiments, prototypes, and recommendations; the title-level supplier reference is not passage evidence.
The passages describe an emerging paradigm, research directions, and prospective orchestration rather than established AIOps-driven orchestration.
The passages describe access, evaluations, possible deployment, and adoption rhetoric, but not broad established deployment, market maturity, or standardization of DeepSeek-R1.
The passages describe different robotic systems and research prototypes rather than maturity of the specified 5-DOF manipulator.
One trust-tier A review explicitly says social robots are not widely deployed and other passages describe research or limited contexts.

items.quote: In summary, AI-driven analytics also underpin underwriting processes through automated and less biased risk assessment and increasingly personalized insurance offers.
items.rationale: A trust-tier A passage directly describes AI-driven analytics as an operating component of underwriting.
A trust-tier A passage says AI innovations are reshaping payment systems, but it does not clearly establish deployment of the exact candidate AI-powered payment processing.
